P01.rationale: No portrait or human figure appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely typographic.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits of any kind on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present.

P10.rationale: The numerals 1, 2, and 3 are rendered at a larger size than body text but are not truly oversized or ghost-decorative; they function more as list markers than dramatic typographic elements.

P11.rationale: Statistics are cited inline as text (e.g., '2.9%', '30–50%') but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or data-visualisation frames bound to those numbers.

P12.rationale: The layout is clean and structured but leaves a significant empty region in the lower third of the page, preventing a truly dense, magazine-quality fill.

P13.rationale: The light blue header band provides a minimal atmospheric element, but the rest of the page is flat white with no texture or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup of any kind appears on the page.

N07.rationale: The page is entirely text-based with no imagery at all, so stock-photo genericness is not an issue, though the absence of specific visuals keeps it generic by default.

N08.rationale: The bottom quarter of the page is largely empty white space with no content, creating a noticeably under-filled region.

N10.rationale: There are no photos on the page, so text-over-busy-photo legibility issues do not arise.
